text: The plan covers County Government, local municipalities, school districts, and volunteer firefighters

citations.text: The County of Ulster is currently seeking proposals for actuarial services for the Ulster County Self-Insurance Plan which includes County Government, local municipalities, school districts, and volunteer fire fighters.

text: The County seeks an annual actuarial valuation of its self-insured workers’ compensation program

citations.text: The County is seeking a qualified Actuary Firm to provide an annual actuarial valuation of the County’s self-insured workers compensation program.

text: The County seeks annual liability estimates for years ending December 31, 2026, 2027, and 2028, with two optional one-year renewals for 2029 and 2030

citations.text: The County is asking for an estimate of the liability annually for a three-year period ending December 31, 2026, 2027, and 2028 with two optional one-year renewals for years ending December 31, 2029 and 2030.

text: Each annual report must include a three-year forecast

citations.text: Each year, the awarded vendor will produce a report containing a three-year forecast.

text: The plan covers employees of the County, 20 towns, 3 villages, 7 school districts, 26 volunteer fire districts, 1 city, and Ulster County Community College

citations.text: The plan provides coverage to employees of the County, 20 towns, 3 villages, 7 school districts, 26 volunteer fire districts within the County, 1 city, and Ulster County Community College.

text: The plan is administered by County employees with a third-party administrator and overseen by the County Executive

citations.text: The administration of this plan is accomplished with County employees in conjunction with a Third-party administrator and is overseen by the County Executive.

text: The County seeks independent analysis of workers’ compensation loss reserves, including incurred but not reported losses

citations.text: Workers’ Compensation Actuarial Services will consist of an independent actuarial analysis of the loss reserve (incurred but not reported) related to the Workers’ Compensation Coverage.

text: The study must estimate year-end total reserves on discounted and undiscounted bases

citations.text: The study must provide an estimate of the total reserves as of the end of the year on both a discounted and undiscounted basis.
